Standard: Cartridge activated devices/Pyrotechnic actuated devices and propulsion component reliability are not less than 99.9% at the 90% confidence level in the intended operating environment. Cartridge activated devices are IAW MIL-C-83124, Requirements section and Quality Assurance Provisions section. Pyrotechnic actuated devices are IAW MIL-C-83125, Requirements section and Quality Assurance Provisions section. Rocket catapults, propellent actuated catapults, and rocket motors are IAW MIL-P-83126, Requirements section and Quality Assurance Provisions section. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Reliability for all CAD/PAD, and propulsion components are verified IAW the standard.
